## Final prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single artwork texture atlas for background cards in the Anansi virtual-art website. Create an exact edge-to-edge 4-column by 2-row grid of EIGHT visibly different original paintings. All eight tiles are equal dimensions, with no gutters, borders, frames, signatures, letters, watermark or perspective. Each tile is a complete portrait-aspect artwork (overall atlas landscape 5:3, individual tiles 5:6). Row 1 from left: dramatic crimson and charcoal gestural abstraction; lush emerald botanical still life with broad painterly leaves; cobalt and golden ochre geometric color-field composition; expressive earth-toned portrait of an adult woman. Row 2 from left: midnight indigo cityscape with coral-lit windows; sunny lavender and yellow impasto floral composition; minimalist black ink sweeping calligraphic marks on ivory paper with no actual writing; burnt orange and turquoise cubist still life with pottery. Varied palettes, subjects, marks, and strong individual identities, tasteful museum-quality painterly surfaces. Paintings flat facing the viewer, fill every tile completely. These are synthetic illustrative artworks, not real artist submissions. Avoid similarity to a repeated beige seascape.
